notes.title: Big Development Update
notes.content:
We are closing in on testing the game, if you want to test please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/uvd8AyrvUF]discord server[/url] in ballfrogs game description and get to know us to be invited to join.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/uvd8AyrvUF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40802941/005d697438a299930832a68f0ec9f34e2b0d7dc5.png[/img][/url]
